title: It's sewn crooked
text: It's sewn crooked. So, the hamper is ok.. In hindsight the ones with the removable bag would have been better. But it's a little flimsy, and the seams are sewn crooked, so when I put in the poles to prop it up, it is kind of wonky. It still works, and the wheels roll fairly well on the tile, so I didn't send it back. Just not the best.
